rows.name: Is this the place you were on about?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]This is it all right. At the end of the road[XENO:n ]
there's a path to Colony 6.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But there's no sign of Juujuu. If my vision was right,[XENO:n ]
he should be around here somewhere.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I'm sure he would have gone along this road.[XENO:n ]
I just hope nothing's happened to him yet.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]Any chance he went up that way?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's not safe around here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I doubt Juujuu would go off the beaten[XENO:n ]
track if he could avoid it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Got it. We'll search along the road.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
